entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: Former guildhall of the Azorius Senate on Ravnica, destroyed by the Parhelion and now the nature preserve Old Prahv.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose hall was Prahv.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: Angel who revealed the Ghost Quarter of Agyrem and warned about Szadek.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Airborne angel-fortress that crashed into Prahv.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Dimir vampire lord Feather warned about.

entities.name: Ghost Quarter of Agyrem
entities.description: District Feather revealed to the guild leaders.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: Azorius leader under whom New Prahv's reconstruction began.

events.summary: In the halls of Prahv, Feather reveals the Ghost Quarter of Agyrem and the fate of the Parhelion, and warns of the Dimir vampire lord Szadek.
events.quote: the angel Feather revealed to the guild leaders the existence of the Ghost Quarter of Agyrem

events.summary: The Parhelion strikes Prahv, collapsing three towers and shattering the blue dome.
events.quote: Prahv was struck by none other than the Parhelion itself

events.summary: Reconstruction of New Prahv finally begins after Isperia assumes leadership of the guild.
events.quote: It was only after Isperia assumed leadership of the guild that reconstruction efforts of New Prahv finally began.

relations.quote: the former guild hall for the Azorius Senate on Ravnica
the ongoing threat posed by the Dimir vampire lord
after Isperia assumed leadership of the guild
